shared_or_similar_visual_information: A fill selecting one side of a visible geometric or plotted boundary. On the left, use the gray half-plane below the solid horizontal line. On the right, use the gray polygon inside rectangle ABDF beneath the segments AC and CE.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It consists of points satisfying the lower-side inequality, including equality along the solid line. Right image: It selects the part of the rectangle outside the two unshaded triangular pieces.
Rationales: The shaded half-plane records which coordinate pairs meet an inequality. The geometric fill delimits a measured area after removing the depicted cutout or excluded portion.
